findings.note: Last paragraph: "San Francisco and San Mateo County handle these conditions the same way." No ledger claim supports any San Mateo County rule or any match between the two (SR-2: never imply one city's or county's rule matches another's). Delete the sentence; if the reader needs a pointer for other places, use only "Local rules vary; check with your city or county."
First paragraph: "It says nothing about any other city or county." This is an absence-of-law claim with no statute_absence claim in the ledger (SR-6). Delete the sentence.

The section opens with "This is a San Francisco rule, not California law." before any rule is stated, so "This" has no referent. Move the sentence after the rule, or name it (for example "San Francisco Housing Code section 351 is a San Francisco rule, not California law.").
